title: Leveraging Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) for the Exchange of Wearable Inertial Sensor Data: Design and Development Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.30956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous monitoring with wearables can support the assessment of frailty, functional decline, and movement disorders, but raw inertial measurement unit (IMU) recordings are typically stored in proprietary files that electronic health records cannot exchange or interpret. HL7 Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) standardizes health data exchange, yet existing FHIR profiles for personal health devices target spot measurements and short waveforms, not long multichannel motion recordings with their recording context and activity labels. We present WHIR (Wearable Health Interoperable Recordings), a FHIR R5-based information model and implementation guide for wearable IMU recordings. Metadata requirements were derived from a review of 23 published human activity recognition datasets and formalized in a FHIR-independent information model, which was then mapped to FHIR R5 and authored in FHIR Shorthand. translated_title: 利用快速医疗互操作性资源（FHIR）实现可穿戴惯性传感器数据交换：设计与开发研究
translated_abstract: 通过可穿戴设备进行持续监测可以支持对身体衰弱、功能衰退和运动障碍的评估，但原始惯性测量单元（IMU）记录通常以专有文件格式存储，电子健康记录（EHR）系统无法对其进行交换或解读。HL7快速医疗互操作性资源（FHIR）标准规范了健康数据的交换，然而现有的针对个人健康设备的FHIR配置文件主要面向单点测量和短时波形，而非带有记录上下文和活动标签的长时间多通道运动记录。我们提出了WHIR（Wearable Health Interoperable Recordings，可穿戴健康互操作记录），这是一个基于FHIR R5的信息模型和面向可穿戴IMU记录的实施指南。元数据需求来自对23个已发表的人类活动识别数据集的综述，并在一个独立于FHIR的信息模型中进行了形式化，随后映射到FHIR R5并使用FHIR Shorthand编写。原始信号保存在f……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了基于FHIR R5的WHIR信息模型与实施指南，首次使可穿戴设备的长时多通道惯性传感器数据（包含记录上下文与活动标签）能够通过FHIR标准在医疗信息系统中实现标准化交换与互操作。
en_tdlr: This study presents WHIR, a FHIR R5-based information model and implementation guide that enables standardized exchange of long-duration multichannel wearable IMU recordings, including recording context and activity labels, within healthcare information systems.
